name: wordmark, tagline and url hold
looks: A small pixel-grid mark sits beside the brand name typed on with a blinking cursor. An italic serif tagline fades up underneath, then a small underlined mono URL fades in below that, and the frame holds.
build: The name types on character by character (kit.typeOn) in a mono-accented display face, cursor blinking on the beat. The serif tagline reveals with a clipPath wipe and a small x slide. The mono URL fades and slides up 4-6px after a short pause, with a thin underline.
sound: A light key tick per character, a soft swell under the tagline, and the bed fading out over the hold.
prompt: Close on the brand's mark and name typing on with a blinking cursor, an italic tagline fading up underneath it, and a small underlined site address fading in last. Hold the finished card at least a second so the message can land.
